decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval: The development, subject to the conditions which have been imposed, would preserve the appearance of the Conservation Area, the setting of the listed buildings , the appearance of the building and the street scene. It would not detract from neighbouring residential amenity. The scheme complies with the Council's U.D.P. policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2.(Conservation Areas), ENV-B.2.5 (Setting of Listed Buildings) and H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 4 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Installation of roof light to rear elevation and installation of a window to front elevation of lower ground floor to dwellinghouse.
